organization.name_ja: ロイヤルカナン ジャポン合同会社

affected.note: 77,709 pet owners' purchase history data and 77,117 pet owners' point balance data were downloadable by other registered animal hospitals; the two groups likely overlap. Birthdates, addresses, phone numbers, email addresses, passwords and card data were not included. The company identified 3 and 15 hospitals respectively that may have downloaded the data.

summary.en: Royal Canin Japon reported that a wrong access-rights setting applied by its maintenance contractor on 2023-05-24 let animal hospitals registered on its Vets Home Delivery (VHD) diet-food site download data on pet owners linked to other hospitals. Purchase histories of 77,709 owners and point data of 77,117 owners leaked to some hospitals.
summary.ja: ロイヤルカナン ジャポンは、療法食購入サイト「ロイヤルカナン ベッツホームデリバリー（VHD）」で、2023年5月24日に委託先が誤ったアクセス権限を設定したため、登録動物病院が他院に紐づくペットオーナーのデータをダウンロードできる状態になったと公表した。77,709名の購入履歴と77,117名の保有ポイントに関するデータが一部の動物病院に漏えいした。
